"The effect of adherence to ACLS protocols on survival of event in the setting of in-hospital cardiac arrest."

According to this study, if ACLS guidelines are strictly adhered to, and the healthcare team doesn't deviate from them, they are highly effective in achieving the return of spontaneous circulation. As expected, if practitioners do not follow the guidelines, outcomes are sub par.
"Regenerative Medicine and Organ Transplantation: Past, Present, and Future"

This is probably going to be the most exciting advancement in medicine over the course of the next few decades. The work being done with tissue and organ regeneration is fascinating. In the very very near future, organ donor lists will be a thing of the past, which is awesome. Unfortunately, we are right at that cusp where many on the donor lists will no be able to benefit from this research.
